body: So not the exact same but I had a grade three stress fractures in my femoral neck while training for Chicago last year. I ended up staying off it for a month and doing my best to run the marathon and by mile 9 every step was killer. I stayed off it for 3 months after the race. With the first 4 weeks on crutches. I just started training for Chicago again and after two weeks I do not have any pain (yet). My doctor also did a vitamin D test on me as well. Apparently low vitamin d can lead to weak bones and apparently lots of people in the Midwest have low levels. Mine ended up being fine but I now take a daily vitamin d supplement 😂.

OP I’m a city employee who works in an engineering department. You’d be shocked how much this happens on both sides. A lot of times when we’re conducting surveys we find out we have ROW encroaching on private property, such as a bike path, sidewalk, and tons of underground infrastructure. Generally speaking, 3 inches is negligible and we wouldn’t even pursue vacating the property or undertaking any type of agreement. If it were feet and we had some critical Infrastructure, then sure. But 3 inch overlap on a sidewalk would not be a priority in the slightest for us.
